method.comparison: Hold the model, raw flag point, source clock and short-window admission rule fixed. The current path requires one admitted four-second window. The proposed path permits the independent two-second check when the primary explicitly reports a speech-admission skip. Record every skipped window and distinguish checked, elevated, and useful exact-time coverage. The overall result is outside this comparison.
method.input: From each retained six-second matched source group, take the same 1.65 s region in all four foreground and original-mix versions. Center on the known edit subject to source bounds, then put the excerpt at 2.200 s in a six-second file with silence outside it. Room-only controls use the centered excerpt at the same destination. This is a bounded sparse-speech test, with labels used to prepare fixtures before inference only.
method.sources: Replay the previously bound three-generator panel. Each of its twelve groups contains a synthetic edit, an untouched file and same-speaker and other-speaker human edits. Eight additional deliveries comprise foreground and mixed routes for the four isolated room inputs. Controlled excerpt placement and earlier project source exposure apply.
